recipes.mutation: use a model with a different SHA-256
same architecture converted to a different weight layout
change one state-affecting context or rope parameter
XOR one non-magic header byte with 0x01
XOR one middle payload byte with 0x01
retain fewer bytes than the minimum header
truncate one byte before a declared page boundary
replace a length field with the maximum representable unsigned value

requirements: Never run a corruption case without a per-process watchdog.
Preserve the original checkpoint and record both SHA-256 digests.
The harness must not infer field offsets; use a fork-specific format adapter.
